notes.title: Virtual Robots now available on Steam
notes.content:
Probably the nerdiest game ever made, if you want to consider it a game. Virtual Robots - Robot programming simulator was made for people who like programming and robots. Objective of this game is to WRITE code for your robots.
You will see a lot of compiler error messages, you will see your robots bumping into each other and of course you will see how your robots don't understand what you are trying to tell them.

Nonetheless, once you start to understand your robots you will see that writing code for them is not that hard.

Good luck, have fun and don't let the first missteps discourage you.
